summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed an 8-K regarding a $100M increase in its existing credit facilities, bringing total commitments to $1.9B. The increase consists of a $70M expansion of the revolving credit facility (to $1.545B) and a $30M expansion of the term loan facility (to $355M), effective June 29, 2026. Regions Bank joined as a new lender via a Joinder Agreement. No special situation is triggered; this is a routine credit facility amendment with no equity impact, change of control, or strategic event. No risk-arb angle exists as this is purely a financing action.
